mapper.sql: id, application_id, application_reference, applicant_id, applicant_name, kind, amount, currency, method, reference, status, expires_at, student_txn_no, proof_media_id, submitted_at, verified_by, verified_at, rejection_reason, version, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time
mapper.insert: insert into nad_application_payment (application_id, application_reference, applicant_id, applicant_name, kind, amount, currency, method, reference, status, expires_at, create_by, create_time) values (#{applicationId}, #{applicationReference}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{kind}, #{amount}, #{currency}, #{method}, #{reference}, #{status}, #{expiresAt}, #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.select: select from nad_application_payment where application_id = #{applicationId} and kind = #{kind} and status in ('PENDING', 'PROOF_SUBMITTED') limit 1
select count(*) from nad_application_payment where application_id = #{applicationId} and kind = #{kind} and status = 'CONFIRMED'
select count(*) from nad_application_payment where application_id = #{applicationId} and kind = #{kind} and status in ('PROOF_SUBMITTED', 'CONFIRMED')

select from nad_application_payment
status in ('PROOF_SUBMITTED', 'CONFIRMED', 'REJECTED') and exists (select 1 from nad_application a where a.id = nad_application_payment.application_id and a.current_status <> 'DRAFT') and status = #{status}
and (reference like concat('%', #{q}, '%') or student_txn_no like concat('%', #{q}, '%') or applicant_name like concat('%', #{q}, '%'))
order by (status = 'PROOF_SUBMITTED') desc, coalesce(submitted_at, create_time) desc, id desc
select config_value from sys_config where config_key = #{key} limit 1
select count(*) from nad_application_payment where application_id = #{applicationId} and kind = #{kind} and create_time >= #{since}
select count(*) from nad_application_payment where student_txn_no = #{txnNo} and application_id != #{applicationId}
select id from nad_application_payment where status = 'PENDING' and expires_at <= #{now}
select proof_media_id from nad_application_payment where applicant_id = #{applicantId} and proof_media_id is not null
mapper.insert: insert into nad_application_payment_event (payment_id, from_status, to_status, actor_kind, actor_id, note, created_at) values (#{paymentId}, #{from}, #{to}, #{actorKind}, #{actorId}, #{note}, #{at})
